facts.fact: A Ministry of Finance principal economist said at the Dynamism in MSR kick-off workshop in Blantyre that data integration will link the Malawi Social Registry directly with existing functional management systems to allow data exchange, with Dowa and Balaka as pilot districts.

systems.owner: Poverty Reduction and Social Protection Division

facts.fact: The World Bank mission reports that as of March 2025 the Unified Beneficiary Registry held 4.2 million households (17 million people) in 27 of 28 rural districts, with five programmes using the data for targeting and research.

The mission reports CORE-MIS is being used as foundational software so programme systems (Mbwezera MIS, SCTP MIS, COMSIP Integrated MIS, M'bwezera Monitoring Tool) share core modules, beneficiary IDs and reporting structures, with Mbwezera MIS still being configured.
The mission reports government has identified system integration and on-demand registration as ways to update the UBR, and agreed to roll out on-demand registration in selected districts.

NLGFC confirmed that in FY April 2024-March 2025, 95,520 SCTP and 195,520 CSPWP beneficiaries were enrolled on e-payments in 10 districts and received payments in e-wallets, with 17 districts to be paid through 6 payment service providers by 15 April 2025.

systems.owner: Poverty Reduction and Social Protection Division

facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report says the Malawi Social Registry (formerly the Unified Beneficiary Registry) has a dedicated integration module with the NRB, with 3,233,708 of 4,377,763 households (about 74%) linked to a National ID.

UNDP's IDT4M report says NRB generated 1,101,631 QR codes for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme, verified data was uploaded into the FISP application on 12 December 2025, and field testing confirmed readiness for pilot rollout.

note: Report does not say two programmes draw on the registry, nor that it links to civil registration, health, education or tax.

facts.fact: The UNDP report says more than 4 million Malawi Social Registry (formerly UBR) household records, 75 percent, have been integrated with the National ID.

The report says the Social Registry is being upgraded with a new software platform and a dedicated module for real-time integration with NRB, for automated identity verification of all programme beneficiaries.

note: The report links the registry to the National ID only; no other sector is named, and it does not say how many programmes share the registry.
Document states nothing this study asks for Malawi.

facts.fact: GIZ Malawi says the government launched a Data Sharing App for the Malawi Social Registry for data exchange between institutions, and that registry data is already used by WFP Malawi and the GIZ EnDeV Programme.
facts.system: Data Sharing App for the Malawi Social Registry
